resources.string: Incoming calls ring this phone normally. If you don\'t answer within the chosen number of rings, your carrier forwards the call to the number below.
Forwarding is ON → %1$s after %2$d rings (~%3$d s)
Phone permissions are required to send the forwarding code.

Note: forwarding is provided by your mobile carrier and may incur charges or be unsupported on some networks (e.g. CDMA). The no-reply timer is set in 5-second steps (5–30 s), so the actual ring count may be rounded. Use only on a phone you are authorised to configure.
